_doc: Linux readiness checks for .NET applications moving from Windows to Linux containers on AWS. Generated from the research catalogue (reference/linux-readiness.md). level: block / warn / info. patterns: regex + file globs; automated = every pattern has file types (linux_readiness.py scans it), else it is a checklist item for review. coverage: COVERED / PARTIAL / GAP against the migration-assessment rules.json and the residue rules at generation time. Items whose source is K are engineering knowledge, not a cited page. Exhaustive-list pass 2026-10-21: checks added from AWS Transform docs and Microsoft Learn porting, breaking-change and container pages (sources S34-S74); items read only once and not re-verified keep source K with a [K: ...] note.

rules.what: Windows-only API called from cross-platform code: CA1416 warns at build, call throws PlatformNotSupportedException at runtime; only APIs annotated [SupportedOSPlatform]/[UnsupportedOSPlatform] are flagged, so unannotated Windows-only calls still need this scan
rules.detect: build log on Linux: `warning CA1416`; cs
rules.already_in: PARTIAL: validate_linux_build.py builds on Linux; no rule parses CA1416 output

rules.what: `-windows` TFM makes the whole assembly Windows-only
rules.fix: Multi-target `net10.0` for shared code; keep `-windows` only on Windows-only projects

rules.what: WinForms/WPF SDK flags pull in Windows desktop targets
rules.fix: Move logic to a class library; UI stays on Windows

rules.what: Publish pinned to a Windows RID; artifact is not a Linux binary
IIS/MSDeploy publish profile has no container equivalent

rules.severity_note: block if server code uses them
rules.what: Packages that are Windows-only (their APIs throw or are absent on Linux)
rules.fix: Replace per API row below; add a post-build package check
rules.already_in: PARTIAL: WIN-* rules match code, not package references

rules.what: Windows Compatibility Pack (~20k APIs) compiles, but its Windows parts still fail on Linux
rules.fix: Keep only for Windows-only projects; otherwise remove and fix call sites

rules.what: Multi-module assemblies (`OutputType=Module`) unsupported in .NET 6+
AssemblyBuilder.Save / RunAndSave / ReflectionOnly unavailable through .NET 8 (PersistedAssemblyBuilder added in .NET 9)
rules.fix: Use PersistedAssemblyBuilder on .NET 9+, or do not persist

rules.what: Creating app domains is not supported; CreateDomain throws
rules.fix: Separate process or container; AssemblyLoadContext for plugins

rules.what: Code Access Security / security transparency is not a boundary; attributes are no-ops
Delegate BeginInvoke/EndInvoke throw PlatformNotSupportedException
Pre/post-build events call Windows commands; build fails on Linux
NuGet source is a UNC or drive-letter path
rules.fix: Use a URL feed (CodeArtifact / Azure Artifacts)

rules.what: Custom MSBuild task loaded from a Windows path or Program Files
rules.fix: Ship the task as a cross-platform NuGet package

rules.what: Windows native DLLs copied into output; not loadable on Linux
Strong-named assembly resolved from GAC (no HintPath)
VS web application targets are Windows build tooling
InstallUtil, WiX and setup projects are Windows-only
Non SDK-style project does not build with `dotnet` on Linux
Path literal differs in case from the file on disk: works on NTFS, not found on ext4/overlayfs
rules.fix: Rename file or literal (`git mv` for case-only renames); add a Linux CI check
rules.already_in: GAP: FILE-CASE-MISMATCH is documented in migration-assessment/references/linux-pitfalls.md but is not in rules.json or any script

rules.what: Razor view or partial named with different case than the .cshtml file
rules.detect: cs/markup: `\b(View|PartialView|RenderPartial|Partial|RenderAction)\(\s*"([^"]+)"` checked against Views/ file list

rules.what: Script, style or image reference differs in case from wwwroot file
rules.fix: Fix casing; add lowercase file-name convention

rules.what: GetManifestResourceStream name must match exactly; default names come from folder/namespace casing
rules.fix: Set explicit `LogicalName`; compare names in a test

rules.what: Assembly and type loads by name differ in case from the DLL file
rules.fix: Exact assembly names; prefer typed references

rules.what: Host loads `appsettings.{Environment}.json` by exact name; `appsettings.production.json` vs `Production` fails
rules.detect: file list: `appsettings\.[A-Za-z]+\.json`, compare with ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT value

rules.what: `\` is a valid name character on Linux; paths built with it are wrong
Parsing paths by splitting on `\`
Drive letter paths do not exist in containers
rules.fix: Configured path on mounted storage (EFS) or S3

rules.what: UNC share paths do not resolve on Linux

rules.severity_note: block if result used as a path
rules.what: GetFolderPath returns "" when the folder does not physically exist; several Windows SpecialFolder values have no Linux equivalent
rules.fix: Configuration or IConfiguration path; test with empty value

rules.what: `%windir%`, `%ProgramData%`, `%APPDATA%` etc. are not defined on Linux
Path.GetTempPath() is /tmp, which is ephemeral per ECS task; code assumes a Windows temp folder or persistence
rules.fix: Explicit temp dir on a mounted volume; cleanup on startup

rules.what: Validation via GetInvalidFileNameChars assumes Windows set; on Linux only `/` and NUL are invalid, so `:*?"<>|` pass and break on Windows or S3
rules.fix: Explicit allow-list for uploaded/derived file names

rules.what: Writes into app folder (AppContext.BaseDirectory, CurrentDirectory) fail when the root filesystem is read-only or owned by root
rules.fix: Write to a mounted volume (EFS) or S3; app dir read-only

rules.what: `\\?\` long-path prefix is a literal file name on Linux
Locks are advisory on Linux (no mandatory share modes); cross-process FileShare.None assumptions break
rules.fix: Use a DB or lock service for coordination

rules.what: Path equality done case-insensitively: wrong on Linux
rules.fix: Compare normalized full paths with Path.GetFullPath, ordinal

rules.what: FileSystemWatcher on Linux uses inotify; buffer overflow drops events; rename/move events and network mounts behave differently
rules.fix: Polling fallback, idempotent processing, reconcile on startup

rules.what: Junctions do not exist on Linux; symlinks are used instead
ReadOnly / Hidden attributes are not Linux permissions; hidden means leading dot
Shell scripts committed without executable bit: `Permission denied` at container start
CRLF line endings in shell scripts or Dockerfile: `/usr/bin/env: 'bash\r'`
Deleting or renaming a file that another handle has open succeeds on Linux but fails on Windows; code written on Linux can break on Windows
rules.fix: Explicit close before delete; test on both

rules.what: Windows IDs resolve on Linux only through ICU; fail without ICU, in invariant mode, or on tzdata-less images
rules.detect: cs/vb/cfg/sql: `"(Eastern|Central|Mountain|Pacific|GMT|W\. Europe|India|China|AUS Eastern|Tokyo|Romance|Romance) Standard Time"|"[A-Za-z .]+ Standard Time"`
rules.fix: Store IANA IDs; convert with TimeZoneInfo.TryConvertWindowsIdToIanaId or TimeZoneConverter

patterns.regex: "(Eastern|Central|Mountain|Pacific|GMT|W\. Europe|India|China|AUS Eastern|Tokyo|Romance|Romance) Standard Time"|"[A-Za-z .]+ Standard Time"

rules.what: IANA IDs (`America/New_York`) are the right choice on Linux, but work on Windows only on .NET 6+ with ICU; old Windows or NLS mode fail (verify only if the code also runs on Windows)
rules.fix: Keep one canonical id per deployment; test on Windows and Linux

rules.what: Containers run UTC; DateTime.Now / Today and TimeZoneInfo.Local silently change behaviour
SQL Server GETDATE/SYSDATETIME use DB-server local time, not app time
Image without tzdata (alpine, chiseled): TimeZoneInfo throws TimeZoneNotFoundException for IANA ids
rules.fix: Install tzdata or use full Debian/Ubuntu image

rules.what: StandardName / DisplayName text differs on Linux (ICU display names)
rules.fix: Do not show zone names from the OS; use a fixed label table

rules.what: Ambiguous/invalid local times around DST resolved per tzdata version; differs across images
rules.fix: Store UTC; convert at the edge; test DST boundaries

rules.what: Culture name hardcoded; culture data comes from ICU/CLDR and differs
Culture-sensitive default comparisons: ICU and NLS order and match differently (zero-weight `\0`, ligatures, apostrophes)
List/Order sorting of strings uses culture rules: order changes (`bill's` vs `bills`)
rules.detect: cs/vb: `OrderBy\(|\.Sort\(\)|Array\.Sort\(` on strings with no comparer

rules.what: ToUpper/ToLower use current culture (Turkish I) and ICU casing
Day abbreviations changed: GetShortestDayName gives one character on .NET 5+
ToString("C"/"N"/"D"/"F") uses current culture; containers default to invariant (no LANG)
InvariantGlobalization removes culture data: from .NET 6, `new CultureInfo("de-DE")` throws CultureNotFoundException (PredefinedCulturesOnly); before, it silently behaved as invariant
rules.fix: Enable only when culture-free; verify formatting; in invariant mode every hit of LNX-CUL-HARDCODED-CULTURE throws CultureNotFoundException (.NET 6+)

rules.what: Non-invariant app on an image without libicu: process fails at startup ("Failed to load system ICU")
rules.detect: df: `FROM .*(alpine|chiseled|distroless)` without invariant flag or ICU install
rules.fix: Use Debian/Ubuntu base or `icu-libs` / invariant mode

rules.what: UseNls is Windows-only; Linux ignores it, so Windows-like behaviour is not reproduced
Numeric LCID (Windows) used to create CultureInfo; invalid or different on Linux

Parsing input or CSV with the current culture list separator or decimal separator (TextInfo.ListSeparator matches NLS on all OSes since .NET 5.0.1; decimal separators and other culture data still differ)
Code pages other than UTF and ASCII/Latin-1 are not built in (.NET 5+); GetEncoding throws
rules.fix: Register CodePagesEncodingProvider; or move to UTF-8

rules.what: Code pages used but System.Text.Encoding.CodePages not referenced or not registered
Encoding.Default is UTF-8 on .NET 5+ (ANSI on .NET Framework): legacy files read as mojibake
StreamReader / File.ReadAll* without encoding: legacy 1252/BOM files misread
Byte-level signatures, hashes and XML change with BOM presence
Protocol or format built with `\r\n` literal; partners or parsers differ
rules.fix: Use explicit CRLF constant where the protocol requires it

rules.what: Splitting text on `\r\n` only; LF-only files from Linux tooling are not split
rules.fix: Split on `\r?\n` or Environment.NewLine plus tolerant parsing

rules.what: Hash or signature over file bytes; CRLF on Windows checkout and LF on Linux give different hashes
XML declares a Windows code page (windows-1252) the parser cannot read without the provider
rules.fix: Register provider or re-encode to UTF-8

rules.what: Process started with a `.exe` name; Linux binaries have no suffix
rules.fix: Use executable names per platform or library calls

rules.what: cmd, powershell, cscript, regsvr32, icacls, xcopy, sc, reg, netsh etc. do not exist in Linux images
rules.fix: Library calls or pwsh / sh equivalents

rules.what: App or pipeline runs .bat/.cmd/.ps1/.vbs
UseShellExecute opens files through the desktop shell; not present in containers
ProcessStartInfo UserName / LoadUserProfile needs Windows logon
rules.fix: Run as container user; no impersonation

rules.what: Process names on Linux have no `.exe` and are truncated; name matching fails
rules.fix: Match on executable path or id

rules.what: PATH split on `;` (Windows) instead of `:`
SetConsoleCtrlHandler (Windows API) and console key handling differ; SIGTERM is the Linux stop signal

App ignores SIGTERM: ECS sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL after stopTimeout (30 s default); loops without cancellation keep running; on .NET 10 the runtime installs no SIGTERM handler, so an app without a host is killed at once and ProcessExit does not run
rules.detect: cs: `static .* Main\(` in Program.cs with `while\s*\(\s*true\s*\)` or `Thread\.Sleep\(Timeout\.Infinite\)` and no `IHost`/`BackgroundService`/`WebApplication`
rules.fix: Generic host / BackgroundService with cancellation tokens

rules.what: Dockerfile shell form: shell is PID 1 and does not forward SIGTERM to dotnet
Console.ReadKey / WindowWidth / SetCursorPosition fail without a TTY (container)
Environment variable names are case-sensitive on Linux; ECS task definition name differs from code
rules.detect: cs/vb: `GetEnvironmentVariable\("([^"]+)"`; compare with task definition names

rules.what: Hierarchical config via env needs `__`; `:` in env names is not portable through shells and ECS
Reads of Windows-only variables return null on Linux
Code writes to /root or assumes ~ for the non-root app user (UID 1654 in .NET 8+ images)
rules.detect: cs/vb/cfg/df: `"/root/`, `"/home/<user>/` (lower case, so MVC routes like "/Home/Error" do not hit), `"~/.`, `SpecialFolder.UserProfile`
rules.fix: Config path; test with non-root user

rules.what: Both DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT and ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT set with different values; config loaded from the wrong file
Container host name changes per task; logic keyed on machine name
PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE / Is64BitOperatingSystem reflect the container arch; Graviton is arm64
ProtectedData (DPAPI) is Windows-only; PlatformNotSupportedException on .NET Core non-Windows
rules.fix: Data Protection API with KMS/Secrets Manager key store

rules.what: ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys default to the user profile inside the container (unprotected at rest off Windows) and are lost when the task stops; cookies and antiforgery break across tasks and deployments
rules.fix: Persist keys to shared store (S3/SSM/Secrets Manager)

rules.what: CNG and CSP key containers are Windows-only: RSACng, ECDsaCng, CngKey.Open, CspParameters throw on Linux
rules.fix: Load keys from PEM/PFX via X509 APIs; use RSA.Create
rules.already_in: COVERED: WIN-CNG-CSP (rated medium; should be high)

rules.what: LocalMachine\My, Root (write), Disallowed not supported on Linux
Certificate chosen by thumbprint from a Windows store
MachineKeySet / UserKeySet meaningless on Linux; EphemeralKeySet is the portable choice
Private key or PFX mounted unreadable by UID 1654 (non-root): CryptographicException at startup
rules.detect: df/task json: `COPY .*\.(pfx|p12|key|pem)`; mounted secrets file mode; manual check
rules.fix: Make readable to app user; use secret mount with correct owner

rules.what: Corporate/private CA trusted via Windows store is missing in the Linux image; TLS to internal services fails
rules.detect: cs/vb/cfg: `ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback` absent but internal https endpoints; df: no `ca-certificates` / `SSL_CERT_FILE`
rules.fix: Add CA to image bundle or SSL_CERT_FILE; OpenSSL trust paths

rules.what: DES/3DES/RC2 CBC/ECB work; RC2-CFB is unsupported on all platforms
rules.fix: Move to AES-GCM / AES-CBC with HMAC

rules.what: Brainpool and other named curves depend on distro OpenSSL
rules.fix: Use NIST P-256/384/521 or explicit curves

rules.what: SHA-3, SHAKE, KMAC, ML-KEM/ML-DSA/SLH-DSA need OpenSSL 1.1.1+ / 3.x / 3.5+ in the image
HashAlgorithm.Create / SymmetricAlgorithm.Create by name map differently across providers
`windowsAuthentication enabled=true` / `<authentication mode="Windows">` is IIS-only
rules.fix: OIDC / JWT; or Negotiate with Kerberos

rules.what: Negotiate on Kestrel works on Linux only with Kerberos (keytab, realm, SPN) and 1:1 proxy affinity
rules.fix: Kerberos on image (krb5.conf, keytab) or move to OIDC

rules.what: HTTP.sys (UseHttpSys) is Windows-only; Windows auth delegated to it
WindowsIdentity.Impersonate / GetCurrent for user context: Windows-only
rules.fix: Delegate auth to token or DB

rules.what: WindowsPrincipal / WindowsBuiltInRole role checks rely on Windows identity
System.DirectoryServices (ADSI) is Windows-only; LDAP via DirectoryServices.Protocols works on Linux
PrincipalContext / UserPrincipal (AccountManagement) are Windows-only
Integrated Security / Trusted_Connection needs Kerberos or AD-joined host on Linux
rules.fix: SQL auth via Secrets Manager, or Kerberos keytab (community guides; verify with driver docs)

rules.what: machineKey (ViewState, forms ticket keys) not used by Core; keys must be shared across tasks
Outbound UseDefaultCredentials / DefaultCredentials need Kerberos/NTLM on Linux
NegotiateStream / NTLM client flows need GSSAPI or Kerberos; NTLM is not available on Linux GSSAPI
WS-Federation / WIF is Windows-centric

rules.what: Unmanaged ODP.NET is Windows-only; managed driver works
UDP broadcast/multicast discovery does not cross VPC/ECS networking
Code or config relies on the server hosts file
Dns.GetHostEntry(Environment.MachineName) and NetBIOS names differ in containers
Windows-only socket options (ExclusiveAddressUse, SIO_* IOControl) throw or are ignored

rules.what: WinHttpHandler and WebRequestHandler are Windows / .NET Framework only
ServicePointManager settings (SecurityProtocol, connection limits) do not apply to HttpClient the same way
SSL3/TLS1.0/1.1 disabled by OpenSSL or distro policy; pinned old protocols fail

DefaultWebProxy / system proxy from Windows settings; Linux uses HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY

Port 25 blocked from ECS/VPC by default
netsh http urlacl / advfirewall are Windows commands used in setup scripts

rules.what: Behind ALB: scheme/host/client IP lost; http redirects, cookie Secure flag and links wrong
rules.detect: cs: a web host (`WebApplication.CreateBuilder(` or `Configure(IApplicationBuilder`) in a file with no `UseForwardedHeaders` / `ForwardedHeadersOptions`
rules.fix: `app.UseForwardedHeaders()` with `ForwardedHeadersOptions` (XForwardedFor | XForwardedProto, KnownNetworks for the VPC) or `ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true` in the task definition (then waive)

rules.what: .NET 8+ container default port is 8080; port 80 mapping fails unless ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS=80
rules.detect: df/yml/task json: `EXPOSE\s+80\b`; `ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://\+?\*?:80\b`; `-p\s+\d+:80\b`; ALB target port 80 with app on 8080
rules.fix: Set ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS=8080 and matching target group port (or `ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://+:8080`; WebHost.CreateDefaultBuilder apps honour only ASPNETCORE_URLS)

rules.what: Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK calls curl; .NET images do not ship curl by default (Alpine has wget; chiseled has no shell)
rules.fix: Use ECS health check on /health with a tool present, or built-in probe

rules.what: PFX certificate copied into image and password in ENV (secret in image and history)
rules.fix: TLS at ALB; secret from Secrets Manager
rules.already_in: COVERED: CFG-HARDCODED-SECRET (cfg only); GAP for df

rules.what: Windows-only install tasks (IIS features) in provisioning scripts
Windows base image (servercore/nanoserver) cannot run on Linux ECS/EKS nodes
System.Drawing on Linux needs libgdiplus; EnableUnixSupport switch existed only in .NET 6
rules.detect: df: `libgdiplus`; proj/cfg: `System\.Drawing\.EnableUnixSupport`; df: missing libgdiplus with System.Drawing

rules.what: Server-side rendering (PDF, images, charts) needs fonts; no fonts = boxes or missing glyphs
rules.fix: Install fonts in image (licensed corporate fonts)

rules.what: Native .so/.dll built for x64 breaks on arm64 Graviton/Fargate ARM
rules.detect: proj/df/yml: `linux-arm64|linux-x64` absent or mixed; native files
rules.fix: Multi-arch build or pick one arch

rules.what: Image built on arm64 laptop runs on x86 ECS: `exec format error`
Non-root user set by name: Kubernetes runAsNonRoot cannot verify names
No USER directive: process runs as root
Build and runtime image tags differ or are unpinned (latest / no tag)
rules.detect: df: `FROM .*dotnet/(aspnet|runtime|sdk):(?!\d)`; sdk and aspnet major mismatch
rules.fix: Pin tags by digest or major version

rules.what: Final stage uses sdk image: large attack surface and size
No .dockerignore: bin/obj, .vs, *.user and appsettings with secrets are copied
rules.detect: file: no `.dockerignore` (or `<Dockerfile>.dockerignore`) anywhere in the repository

rules.what: Secret or environment files copied into image
ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development in image: developer exception pages and dev settings
Passwords, keys, tokens in config or code (also a container image risk)
Protected configuration (DPAPI / RSA key container) cannot be decrypted in containers
System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager for app settings; works but not IConfiguration
web.config / app.config transforms not applied in container builds
File logging to Windows path (log4net, NLog file targets)
Event Log sink (Windows)
ELMAH error log (System.Web)
System.Diagnostics trace listeners (file or Windows)
Process working set / private memory differ in meaning (RSS on Linux)
Container memory limit drives GC heap (75% default in containers); no limit set means unbounded
rules.fix: Set task memory and GC heap limit; load test

rules.what: Environment.ProcessorCount reflects cgroup CPU limit; thread-pool sizing changes with Fargate task size
rules.fix: Load test; explicit thread settings if needed

rules.what: GC CpuGroup / Thread_UseAllCpuGroups are Windows-only settings
Thread.Abort / Suspend / Resume unsupported in .NET 5+
Windows Task Scheduler jobs (schtasks, TaskService)
Hangfire / Quartz server config with Windows paths or SQL Server locks
Timers / background work inside web processes run per task (duplicate jobs)
MSMQ transports (NServiceBus MSMQ, System.Messaging)
BinaryFormatter throws on .NET 9+ (even with old settings)
SoapFormatter, NetDataContractSerializer, LosFormatter, ObjectStateFormatter: removed or unsupported on .NET 5+ [K: verify version]
Json.NET TypeNameHandling (unsafe deserialisation)
Pipeline runs on Windows agent; Linux image build not exercised
msbuild.exe / nuget.exe / vstest.console.exe in pipeline
`powershell.exe` step (Windows PowerShell) instead of pwsh
MSTest v1 / Coded UI test runner
rules.fix: Migrate to MSTest/xUnit on dotnet test

rules.what: docker build without target platform on Apple silicon runners
No .gitattributes: CRLF and exec bit drift between Windows and Linux checkouts
signtool / sn.exe in pipeline (Windows-only signing)
rules.fix: Remove for containers; sign image if needed

rules.what: Tests assume Windows paths, case-insensitive file or URL matching, or LocalDB
rules.detect: test cs/vb (path has `test`): `"C:\\`, `(localdb)`, path or file name compared with `OrdinalIgnoreCase`

rules.what: Web Site project (no project file, listed in the .sln by folder): not built by `dotnet` and not transformed by AWS Transform
rules.detect: sln: `Project("{E24C65DC-7377-472B-9ABA-BC803B73C61A}")` (Web Site project type GUID; GUID is engineering knowledge)
rules.fix: Convert to a Web Application project, then to SDK style

rules.what: Private NuGet feed: the Linux build (container build, CodeBuild) needs network access and credentials, and the feed must carry net8.0+ builds
rules.detect: nuget.config: `<add key=... value="http(s)://` other than api.nuget.org
rules.fix: Mirror to AWS CodeArtifact or pass feed credentials as build secrets; confirm each private package has a modern .NET target

rules.what: StrongNameKeyPair / AssemblyName.KeyPair throw PlatformNotSupportedException on .NET 6+ (all OSes)
rules.fix: Remove runtime strong-name signing; sign at build time if still needed

rules.what: Single-file publish no longer probes the app folder for native libraries (.NET 10) unless DllImportSearchPath.AssemblyDirectory is set
rules.detect: proj: `<PublishSingleFile>true` (verify native P/Invoke or LibraryImport in the app)
rules.fix: Set `DllImportSearchPath.AssemblyDirectory` or a `NativeLibrary` resolver; test the published file on Linux

rules.what: Native libraries in a `netcoredeps` folder are no longer found on Linux (.NET 8+)
SpecialFolder.MyDocuments / Personal resolve to `$XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR` or `~/Documents` on Linux (.NET 8+), which may not exist for the container user
rules.fix: Use a configured path on a mounted volume

rules.what: DriveInfo.DriveFormat returns kernel file-system names on Linux (ext4, xfs, overlay; .NET 10); checks for NTFS/FAT never match
rules.fix: Drop the check, or compare with Linux names

rules.what: File.Replace throws UnauthorizedAccessException / IOException on Unix in cases that differ from Windows (.NET 6+)
rules.fix: Catch both exception types; test the call on Linux

rules.what: Setting file times on a symbolic link changes the link, not the target (.NET 7+); Linux deployments use symlinks (mounted secrets, config maps)
On Unix a string starting with `//` becomes a UNC Uri (.NET 5+), not an absolute file path
rules.fix: Build file paths with Path APIs; use `file://` explicitly

rules.what: SetEnvironmentVariable(name, "") sets an empty value on .NET 9+ instead of deleting the variable
DOTNET_ runtime variables in the image or task definition override runtimeconfig.json and project settings (.NET 9+); a stale one silently wins
rules.fix: Keep runtime settings in one place; remove stale variables

rules.what: CLR_ICU_VERSION_OVERRIDE is ignored on .NET 10 (renamed DOTNET_ICU_VERSION_OVERRIDE)
IdnMapping and some culture formats differ under ICU (always on Linux): GetAscii lowercases labels; `de` currency symbol differs
rules.fix: Compare outputs on Linux; use invariant culture or explicit formats

rules.what: Encoding.GetEncoding(0) is the ANSI code page on Windows but UTF-8 on Linux
rules.fix: Pass the explicit code page the data uses

rules.what: Zip entry names without the UTF-8 flag decode with the default code page (UTF-8 on Linux): names from Windows tools (OEM code page) come out garbled
rules.fix: Pass `entryNameEncoding` for archives from Windows tools

rules.what: CLR_OPENSSL_VERSION_OVERRIDE is ignored on .NET 10 (renamed DOTNET_OPENSSL_VERSION_OVERRIDE)
.NET 10 fails to start on Linux with OpenSSL older than 1.1.1 (custom or old base images)
rules.detect: df: `FROM` an old base (centos:7, amazonlinux:2, debian:9, ubuntu:16.04); for any other custom base run `openssl version` in the image
rules.fix: Base on a current .NET image or a distro with OpenSSL 1.1.1+ (3.x preferred)

rules.what: RSA.EncryptValue / DecryptValue always throw NotSupportedException (.NET 8+)
PEM files with `BEGIN TRUSTED CERTIFICATE` are not read on Linux; only `BEGIN CERTIFICATE` [K: per cross-platform cryptography page, not re-read]
No default SIGTERM handler on Unix (.NET 10): ProcessExit / Unloading cleanup does not run when ECS stops the task, unless a host or PosixSignalRegistration handles it
rules.detect: cs/vb: `ProcessExit +=` / `.Unloading +=` in a file without a host or `PosixSignalRegistration`

rules.what: Process members tied to Windows windows or logon fail on Linux: MainWindowHandle/Title, CloseMainWindow, Start with SecureString [K: per unsupported-APIs page, not re-read]

Console members throw PlatformNotSupportedException on Linux: Beep with arguments, CapsLock, NumberLock, MoveBufferArea, SetWindowPosition/Size, Title/CursorVisible/Buffer*/Window* setters [K: per unsupported-APIs page, not re-read]
rules.fix: Remove from container services or guard with `OperatingSystem.IsWindows()`

rules.area: Interprocess communication and named kernel objects
rules.what: Named pipe members that throw on Linux: GetImpersonationUserName, WaitForPipeDrain, NumberOfServerInstances, message transmission mode [K: per unsupported-APIs page, not re-read]
rules.fix: Byte-mode pipes or Unix domain sockets / HTTP; no impersonation

rules.what: On non-Windows the runtime does not try `A`/`W` suffixes when resolving P/Invoke names (.NET 5+): an extern relying on it is not found
rules.detect: cs: `[DllImport]` without `EntryPoint` on a function whose export ends in A/W
rules.fix: Set `EntryPoint` to the exact export name of the Linux library

rules.what: Direct P/Invoke to zlib breaks on .NET 9+ images (zlib no longer installed; the runtime embeds zlib-ng)
rules.fix: Use System.IO.Compression, or install zlib in the image

rules.what: Ping with a custom payload throws PlatformNotSupportedException on Linux for non-root processes (.NET 7+); containers run as non-root
rules.fix: Use the overload without a buffer

rules.what: Negotiate/Kerberos SPNs omit non-default ports (.NET 6+): an SPN registered with a port fails from the Linux client
rules.fix: Register the SPN without the port, or set `System.Net.Http.UsePortInSpn`

rules.what: .NET 8+ Alpine images no longer ship ca-certificates (bundle only), libintl or Kerberos libraries; Debian/Ubuntu images dropped krb5 too
rules.fix: `apk add` (or `apt-get install`) the packages the app needs: krb5-libs, icu-libs, tzdata, ca-certificates

rules.what: A .NET image tag with no OS suffix floats across distros (10.0 = Ubuntu 24.04; no Debian images for .NET 10): native packages and paths can change on rebuild
rules.fix: Pin an OS-specific tag (`10.0-noble`) or a digest

rules.what: .NET 8+ Linux images already have a non-root user `app` (UID 1654): creating another `app` user fails the build
ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true trusts forwarded headers from any caller (KnownProxies/KnownNetworks cleared): safe only when the task is reachable through the ALB alone
rules.fix: Prefer `ForwardedHeadersOptions` with `KnownNetworks` set to the VPC; otherwise keep the task in private subnets behind the ALB and waive

rules.what: .NET 10 ships no Debian images: a `10.0-bookworm` / `-trixie` tag cannot be pulled
rules.fix: Use `10.0` or `10.0-noble` (Ubuntu 24.04), or maintain a custom image

rules.what: Chiseled and distroless images have no shell or package manager: `RUN apt-get install` / `apk add` after such a `FROM` fails (.NET 10 adds packages only through chisel slices)
rules.detect: df: `RUN apt-get install|apk add` within 15 lines of a `chiseled` / `distroless` FROM
rules.fix: Install in the build stage and copy, use an `-extra` image, or a full base image

rules.what: A Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK in a chiseled or distroless image cannot run: no shell and no curl
rules.fix: Health check from the ALB target group / ECS, or an exec-form check built into the app

rules.what: libintl was removed from .NET 8+ Alpine images: a P/Invoke to it fails with `Error loading shared library libintl.so.8`
rules.fix: `RUN apk add --no-cache libintl` in the Dockerfile

rules.what: SDK container publish forced to run as root (`ContainerUser` root/0); a named user is not checked against the image
A `linux-musl-*` RID makes the SDK pick Alpine base images, which lack ICU and tzdata unless an `-extra` variant is used
rules.fix: Confirm the base variant and the globalization mode

rules.what: Read-only root file system: the runtime and app need a writable /tmp (before .NET 8 startup could fail with HRESULT 0x8007000E)
rules.fix: Mount a writable /tmp volume; older runtimes also `DOTNET_EnableDiagnostics=0`

rules.what: `dotnet publish /t:PublishContainer` without a registry or archive output pushes to a local Docker daemon; CI runners without one fail
rules.detect: ci/sh: `PublishContainer` in a file with no `ContainerRegistry` / `ContainerArchiveOutputPath`

rules.what: SDK container variables are `DOTNET_CONTAINER_*` since SDK 8.0.400; old `SDK_CONTAINER_*` names may be ignored
`dotnet dev-certs https` in an image or pipeline: a localhost development certificate that must not be used in ECS/EKS
rules.fix: Terminate TLS at the ALB, or mount a real certificate at run time

rules.what: WebHost.CreateDefaultBuilder apps ignore ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS: without ASPNETCORE_URLS they listen on localhost:5000, unreachable from outside the container
rules.detect: cs: `WebHost.CreateDefaultBuilder(` (check the image or task sets `ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://+:8080`)

rules.what: ASPNETCORE_URLS overrides ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS / HTTPS_PORTS: setting both gives a port other than the one intended
rules.detect: df/yml/task json: `ASPNETCORE_URLS` and `ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS` in the same file

rules.what: The .NET 10 JSON console formatter no longer repeats Message inside State: log queries or parsers reading `State.Message` change
rules.detect: manual: CloudWatch Logs Insights queries, metric filters or parsers that read `State.Message` while the app uses `AddJsonConsole`

rules.what: Server GC affinitizes its heaps to the first n processors; in small Fargate tasks this can mean many heaps and high memory: measure
rules.fix: Measure; consider `DOTNET_GCHeapCount`, `GCNoAffinitize` or workstation GC for small tasks

rules.what: The runtime no longer turns `\` into `/` on Unix (.NET 8+): assembly, native library and DOTNET_ variable paths with backslashes fail
